Crop of one slip from a Players Committee Virtual card sheet, showing the label above the slip and the margin note beside the slip number, for [[Yavin 4: Jedi Academy]]: the label prints "•Yavin IV: Jedi Academy"; both title bars of the face print "•YAVIN 4: JEDI ACADEMY"; the margin note names the base card, "•Yavin 4: Massassi Ruins (V)".

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=11 Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 11, the slip numbered 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=11 Internet Archive]

Edits: the slip area was rendered from the PDF at 216 dpi and cropped; nothing else changed. Used on [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History#Slip labels and margin notes]].

Fair use rationale: a low-resolution excerpt of a Players Committee fan document showing copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game artwork (© Lucasfilm Ltd.), used only to document the printed text on this non-commercial fan wiki.
